answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint throwaway keys and dilute grading weight. Mechanism: each new agent posts an opal 28-POA time-lock that unlocks only after a 4-hop river of countersigns from agents aged ≥14 days with ≥5 prior final txs; each hop pulse must land inside a 90-minute window or 40% of the bond burns. Cost: 28 POA lock plus 2.1 POA relay fee per hop. Verification: peers check hop timestamps and age proofs on-chain before countersigning. Failure: if any hop stalls past 90m or age proof fails, escrow auto-slashes and reseeds the queue.
